subject: SE walkthrough + engineering handoff — availability and agenda
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + SE walkthrough — initial slots

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the interest in Redwood Inference. We'd like to schedule a technical walkthrough that includes a short Solutions Engineering demo (SE) plus time for your engineering/security team to confirm integration constraints. Proposed options: 

- Thu Aug 12, 09:30–10:30 PT (preferred by SE)
- Fri Aug 13, 11:00–12:00 PT

Agenda (high level):
- 10 min intros & goals
- 30 min SE demo (integration points, perf expectations, auth/network)
- 15 min customer Q&A — engineering + security
- 5 min next steps / procurement touchpoints

Karthik (cc) will run the demo. Can you confirm who from your side will join (engineering lead + procurement contact)? If neither slot works, please share a couple of alternatives.

I can attach a short agenda and a network checklist once we lock a time.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmeinc.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>, Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SE walkthrough — initial slots

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — we definitely want both the SE demo and to include our platform engineers and procurement. Quick notes from our side:

- We cannot do Thu 9:30–10:30 (back-to-back leadership meetings).
- Prefer Fri Aug 13 morning (9:00–11:00 PT window) if that works for your team.
- Security asked that the demo run against a non-prod/dev environment or a demo token; they also want a short slide on data flows and retention.

Attaching procurement for scheduling and for any NDA/PO conversations.

Sarah Jenkins
Director, Platform Engineering — Acme Industrial Solutions
sarah.jenkins@acmeinc.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: availability + prep checklist for Acme demo

Priyom / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. If Acme prefers Fri morning, I can hold 09:30–10:30 PT on Aug 13 for a detailed walk-through. Notes for the internal prep: 

- Ask Acme for one sandbox API key or a short-lived demo token and sample payloads
- Confirm which endpoints they want covered (chat/generation vs. embeddings) — assume text generation + KV cache behavior first pass
- Request their network egress/IP allowlist (we usually supply a small set of IPs) — will add to the network_requirements.txt attachment
- I'll prepare a 10-slide deck covering architecture, auth (KMS/HSM integrations), and data retention defaults (SOC2 points)

If Priyom can confirm the attendee list from the customer, I will build the demo script to hit the right integration points.

Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

(Internal-only: blocking my calendar 09:15–10:45 PT on Aug 13 for prep + run-through)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmeinc.com>, procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>, Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SE walkthrough — confirming Fri slot & agenda (attachments)

Sarah / team —

Great — Fri Aug 13 09:30–10:30 PT works for us. Tentative invite pending your confirmation. I attached: 

- 2027-08-09-acme-se-agenda.pdf (short agenda + roles)
- acme-network-requirements.txt (IP ranges and firewall basics)

Proposed final agenda:
1) 09:30–09:40 — Intros, success criteria (Priyom / Sarah)
2) 09:40–10:10 — SE demo (Karthik) — auth, perf, recommended configs
3) 10:10–10:25 — Customer engineering & security Q&A (Mike / Sarah)
4) 10:25–10:30 — Next steps (procurement, PO/NDA owners)

Logistics: I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link; if you prefer Google Meet, say the word. One ask from security: please provide a demo token or sandbox creds and any sample request patterns (payload size / concurrency) so we can tune the demo.

Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2027-08-09-acme-se-agenda.pdf (application/pdf), acme-network-requirements.txt (text/plain)

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmeinc.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + SE walkthrough — confirming Fri slot & agenda

Thanks — confirmed for Fri Aug 13, 09:30–10:30 PT. We'll join with: myself (platform lead), Mike Alvarez (procurement), and two platform engineers (TBD names).

Action items on our side:
- I'll share a sandbox API key (short-lived) and a brief sample payload by EOD Wed Aug 11.
- Procurement will echo any NDA/PO needs; Mike will follow up on paperwork.
- Security would like the session recorded for internal review; please confirm recording is OK.

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Sarah
